formalModel.state: S(t) = (W, R, B, M, Q, C, A); W=warp PC/active-mask, R=symbolic register availability (not numerical values), B=pending writers, M=memory/tile readiness, Q=component queues, C=resource reservations, A=async phases/counters
formalModel.ready: decoded(i) && allCompletionDependenciesDone(i,t) && all(srcRegs(i) ∩ pendingWrites[warp(i)] = ∅) && all(dstRegs(i) ∩ pendingWrites[warp(i)] = ∅) && barrierPhaseReady(i,t)
formalModel.effect: atomically dequeue i; reserve destination writers; reserve target resource/queue; create causal stage and completion tokens
formalModel.release: an execution slot is released only after completion; register hazards after matching writeback; async phase after arrivals=0 and tx-count=0
formalModel.residency: whole-CTA FIFO admission reserves CTA/warp slots, symbolic 32-bit registers per partition and SMEM bytes; all warp instructions and async operations must complete before CTA resource release; real allocation granularity is unsupported
formalModel.instantaneousActivity: resident includes blocked/draining warps; dependency-ready is a subset; eligible also has finite credits and issue budget; actual issue and inflight instruction spans are independent half-open intervals
formalModel.timing: latency L is start→completion; initiation interval II constrains starts; capacity K bounds in-flight operations; queueCapacity bounds waiting tokens. L,II,K are independent model parameters.
formalModel.contractScope: 完整规范用于实现/验证后端。默认commonTransitions是specification-contract，当前后端的已执行规则由trace.meta.modelCoverage明确声明；不因画出队列或端口就声称具有有限队列/背压仿真。

modelCoverage.componentInflightCapacity: enforced K from effective component timing; latency and initiation interval are separate
modelCoverage.residency: FIFO whole-CTA admission; warp/CTA slots, per-partition symbolic register counts and SMEM carveout including 1 KiB CUDA reservation per CTA enforced; no hardware allocation granularity
modelCoverage.warpReadiness: event-derived head-instruction history; eligible ⊆ dependency-ready ⊆ resident; issuing/inflight counted separately from half-open instruction spans
modelCoverage.localQueues: No independently finite local queue; waiting reservations bounded by upstream credits; no downstream backpressure.
modelCoverage.registers: symbolic availability and RAW/WAW producer identity; no bank/port allocation or numerical values
modelCoverage.l1: finite 128-byte teaching lines, LRU, explicitly prewarmed lines; no MSHR or concurrent miss merging
modelCoverage.sharedMemory: 32-bank, 32-bit explicit symbolic lane byte addresses; allocated TMA/scratch buffers and initialized byte ranges checked before LDS
modelCoverage.globalLoads: one logical contiguous 128-byte warp access; no per-lane 32-byte transaction/coalescing simulation
modelCoverage.tma: symbolic contiguous global→shared descriptor; one logical producer per barrier; byte initialization then arrive_expect_tx/complete_tx readiness; bypasses RF/L1
modelCoverage.tensor: single-warp synthetic MMA.SYNC, not four-warp WGMMA
modelCoverage.tensorOperands: register A/B/C fragments; TMA→SMEM→mbarrier→LDS→RF→operand collector→Tensor, without direct SMEM reads by MMA.SYNC

meta.description: 单个 SM 的独立教学性离散事件模型。合成程序具有显式流水级、有限指令缓冲/scoreboard、RAW等待、异步TMA与mbarrier、L1命中/未命中、SMEM bank冲突。不是SASS执行或NVIDIA cycle-accurate测量。
assumptions: 只执行选中 SM；132 个 SM 是 H100 SXM 架构上下文，其余 SM 在本运行中未仿真。
独立教学时钟，不能与城市 tile 运行或 GTSim 原时钟拼接成同一次执行。
固定四个调度分区；warpId % 4 是教学分配策略，非公开硬件放置算法。
warpCount是提交的warp总数，按warpsPerCta组成完整CTA（末CTA可较小）；整CTA按FIFO准入，驻留受warp/CTA槽、分区RF和SMEM预算共同限制。寄存器按线程需求直接相乘，不执行真实硬件分配粒度。
每个分区有限 scoreboard token，覆盖已选中且未写回指令；每个 warp 有限预取/译码 credit；TMA在途有独立上限。
流水线 latency 与 initiation interval 分开建模；算术值不实际执行，无真实 PC、活跃线程mask、SASS校验。
组件间一周期是逻辑交接延迟，所有时序、资源接收速率均为教学参数，不是 Hopper 实测。
全局内存是 NoC 边界外的带宽/延迟服务，未展开真实 L2/HBM、NoC 路由、MSHR、有限链路buffer/credit/backpressure。
Global LD/ST是32线程连续32-bit字的单个128B逻辑访问；未把逐lane地址合并成多个32B硬件transaction。
L1是有限行数LRU教学缓存；l1HitEvery明确设置初始热行，不是实测命中率；未合并并发miss或模拟一致性。
TMA异步提交后warp继续；线性symbolic descriptor明确global source key/SMEM destination key与字节范围，写入完成后才mbarrier就绪；不执行真实tensor-map/多维地址或数值payload。
Tensor示例为独立warp的MMA.SYNC教学操作：A/B/C来自RF片段；TMA缓冲在mbarrier完成后由LDS读入RF，不把mma.sync画成SMEM直连，也不冒充四warp的WGMMA。
SMEM示例32个bank、32-bit字、32个明确不同byte地址；bank=floor(byteAddress/4)%32。TMA与STS scratch分配独立buffer，LDS只读TMA已初始化范围；跨round复用物理buffer在前轮读取完成之后。未覆盖向量访问或swizzle。
I-cache/L0只有流水服务时序，不含tag/miss；texture和constant-cache为结构节点，本程序未使用。
